title: Self-approve the pin PR's gated pull_request runs
body:
## Summary

Removes the last maintainer click from the pin-PR flow: `pull_request` runs on the bot's pin branch queue as approval-gated `action_required` (first-time-contributor gate — observed on #23 as "2 workflows awaiting approval").

- `ci.yml` / `workflow-lint.yml`: revert the dead `branches-ignore: bot/update-tools-image-*` config — `pull_request` branch filters match the **base** branch, so they could never match the bot's head branch.
- `publish-bard-images.yml`: right after opening the pin PR, list `action_required` runs on its branch and `POST /actions/runs/{id}/approve` each (`actions:write` is already granted). Self-approval failure is non-fatal — the dispatched `ci.yml` + `workflow-lint.yml` runs still provide every required check.

Combined with auto-merge being enabled (#22, #20), the loop is now fully unattended: build → pin PR → gated runs self-approved → dispatched checks → `gh pr merge --auto` → merge queue.

## Related issues

None.

- [x] `uv run ruff format --check .` passes.
